message:
Initial commit with task details

Adding .gitkeep for PR creation (default mode).
This file will be removed when the task is complete.

Issue: https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/issues/996
docs(case-study): collect issue 996 raw data and requirements skeleton

fix(report): keep log exports out of the caller's working directory

The agentic report flow exported harness/server session logs with a bare
relative --output, so a run started from a repository checkout dropped
formal-ai-*.lino dumps at the checkout root (#945, E93). Exports now go
into a surviving mktemp directory outside the CWD and the script prints
the final artifact path as its last line.

Also fixes target matching for machine values: normalize_prompt turns
underscores into spaces, so a harness answering with the documented
machine value formal_ai never matched and the learning target was
silently dropped; the machine value is now normalized before comparison.

Closes #945

fix(agentic): fence inlined Links Notation in final answers

Final answers travel into GitHub comments through the hive-mind pipeline,
where unfenced space-indented Links Notation collapses into flowing prose
(hive-mind #2146, captured in the issue #996 session logs). The general
change plan event (completed and planned-not-executed answers) and the
formalization knowledge base are now wrapped in a fenced lino block by a
shared fence helper that grows the fence until the content cannot close
it early.

fix(agentic): honor quoted source text in formalization tasks (#956)

A task that quotes its own source text («…», "…", 「…」, 《…》) now
formalizes that text instead of silently substituting the seeded
«Сказка о рыбаке и рыбке» tale; a quoted title of the tale still selects
the full canonical text. FORMAL_AI_TRACE_REQUESTS=1 additionally traces
agentic_task and formalization_source routing decisions. The recipe moved
to src/agentic_coding/formalization_recipe.rs to respect the 1000-line
file gate.

fix(routing): route Russian «тут» liveness probes to test_status (#979)

«Ты тут?», «вы тут» and «я тут» were absent from the test_status intent
seed, so the exact liveness probe from the reported dialog fell through
to a web search. Pure seed data plus prompts in the regression matrix.

docs(requirements): renumber 22 duplicate requirement IDs (#964)

The later duplicate blocks get fresh unique IDs: the issue-540 block
R396-R407 becomes R537-R548, the issue-657 R480 becomes R549, and the
issue-674 block R501-R509 becomes R550-R558. Cross-references in
docs/requirements-traceability.md (including its now-obsolete collision
preamble and (Lxxxx) disambiguation suffixes), the issue-540 case study,
the issue-540/451 guard tests, and the ARCHITECTURE.md ID range follow.

docs(case-study): complete issue-996 analysis and changelog (#996)

Fills the session-log analysis (Defects A/B/C with line-level evidence
from the sanitized Hive Mind logs), the critical-issue ranking and
dispositions, per-requirement solution plans, the component survey, and
the upstream reports section (agent#293/#294/#295, hive-mind#2146 R-B3).

Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into issue-996-177371167e71

# Conflicts:
#	tests/unit/mod.rs

Strange behavior between:
- https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/pull/997#issuecomment-5247741687
- https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/pull/997#issuecomment-5249414107

Here is the full log (i hope it is full, and there is no another bug): https://gist.githubusercontent.com/konard/fc51f8c8c634fd71d7952c4020ffe9a9/raw/6c7d22814c75f4e89a696b99c368828881ec7e6e/tmp-start-command-logs-isolation-docker-a04e146c-1088-4504-a7f0-860228d6928e.log.txt

We need to download all logs and data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), in which we will reconstruct timeline/sequence of events, list of each and all requirements from the issue, find root causes of the each problem, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

If there is not enough data to find actual root cause, add debug output and verbose mode if not present, that will allow us to find root cause on next iteration.

If issue related to any other repository/project, where we can report issues on GitHub, please do so. Each issue must contain reproducible examples, workarounds and suggestions for fix the issue in code. Also double check to fully apply requirements to entire codebase, so if we have issue in multiple places, it should be fixed in all them.

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
